extraction.method: Allowlisted extraction from signed Core JSON corpora; transaction witnesses are decoded from spendTx; control-depth and future-leaf bytes are independently derived with P2MRLeaf/P2MRBranch tagged hashes.

fixtureDigest.canonicalization: sha256-canonical-json-v1: recursively sort object keys, preserve array order, omit provenance.fixtureDigest.value, JSON.stringify without whitespace, UTF-8

valid.name: two_leaf_spent_hash_sorts_after_sibling
valid.notes: The spent leaf hash is lexicographically greater than its sibling, so the branch preimage must be sibling || spent.

valid.name: three_leaf_two_level_spend_middle_leaf
valid.notes: Tree shape is A || (B || C); control path is C then A, bottom-up.
